name: Perth
industries: Mining and LNG capital programs dominate, with critical minerals and energy transition adding new project portfolios.
intro:
Perth runs the world's biggest mining programs from the world's most isolated capital: iron ore, LNG and now lithium and critical minerals sustain capital projects measured in tens of billions, managed from St Georges Terrace. Project management here is a formal engineering discipline with fly-in-fly-out rhythms, and PMP is its recognised standard; the growing tech and energy-transition scene adds agile demand. Perth's timezone is the Australian exception that favours us: our IST-schedule batches land 11:30 AM – 8:30 PM local — comfortably within the day, no compromise needed. One weekend, full workshop, live instruction. Afterwards you get exam application support built for engineering-heavy applications, full-length mock exams, and direct trainer access for doubts until you clear. Group bookings for FIFO teams rotating through Perth head offices are available with consolidated invoicing.

Perth runs project delivery at resource scale: the iron ore, LNG and emerging critical-minerals programs managed from the city are among the world's largest capital projects, governed by stage gates and owner's-team structures where certification is standard equipment. The energy-transition build-out is adding a parallel wave of certified demand. Training is live online across two consecutive days shown in Perth local time on this page — Perth's timezone alignment with Asia makes the schedule genuinely convenient. Resources-sector project compensation in Perth has its own arithmetic; the sourced entries below give named, dated local figures. The employer list shows the miners-energy-contractors base hiring certified professionals, and owner's teams mobilizing new projects can certify together via private cohorts.
